workerTargetObservation.scope: New worker targets in the helper-owned browser, excluding baseline. URL classification is observational; openerId is retained when CDP supplies it. Nested pthread targets may be absent or have unclassified blob URLs. An empty snapshot or missing target does not prove unexposed child termination. Snapshots do not pause the renderer; browser lifecycle markers and CDP events have separately observed timestamps. No heartbeat or child protocol was injected.

hostControl.scope: Read-only local diagnostic host control. SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers only assign plain flags, without locks or Playwright calls; browser polling cancels via the existing normal API.
